description:
Eleven months after the grand finale of Fairy Tail, master mangaka Hiro Mashima is back with a great adventure beyond imagination! All the steadfast friendship, crazy fighting, and blue cats you've come to expect... IN SPACE!

A young boy gazes up at the sky and sees a streaming bolt of light. The friendly, armor-clad being at his side tells him gently, "That's a dragon." The fact that he's joking isn't important. What's important is the look of wonder on the boy's face... and the galaxy-spanning adventure that's about to take place! Join Hiro Mashima (Fairy Tail, Rave Master) once more as he takes to the stars for another thrilling saga!

(Source: Crunchyroll)

Note: The first two episodes received an online advance screening on March 29. Regular TV broadcast started on April 11, 2021.

name.native: レベッカ・ブルーガーデン

node.description:
Rebecca Bluegarden, the female protagonist, is a kind and energetic girl from the planet Blue Garden who travels to different planets to record videos of and upload to her channel on Aoneko, a video-sharing website, with the goal of obtaining one million subscribers. She pilots a spaceship called the Aqua Wing, which also functions as a seaboat.

Rebecca's power, Leaper, is an Ether Gear that enhances her jumping ability, giving her great speed and agility.

Shiki, the main protagonist of the story, is a friendly yet socially awkward boy who's the sole human denizen of the Granbell Kingdom, a fantasy theme park on the planet Granbell inhabited by robots. He possesses an ability called Ether Gear, which is inherited from the park's animatronic Demon King, granting its user powers akin to those of a machine; Shiki uses a variation known as "Satan Gravity" that allows him to alter and redirect his own personal gravity. Encouraged by his artificial family to go out and make some real friends, he gets swept up on a journey with Rebecca to see new worlds across the cosmos.

Homura Kougetsu is a member of the Demon King's crew on Edens Zero, and a self-described knight from Planet Blue Garden. Her power, Soul Blade, is a type of Ether Gear that allows her to create bladed weapons made of Ether.

name.native: ワイズ・シュタイナー

node.description:
Weisz is a member of Edens Zero and a former thief from the Planet Norma. His power is Machina Maker, an Ether Gear that manipulates machines.

Weisz is a selfish, stubborn, and vain man with a perverted side. However, he does care for his friends, and shows concern for others in his own way. Weisz likes money and bunny girls, and dislikes studying. 

~!He is also the younger version of Professor Weisz from the year X442.!~

name.native: ウィッチ・リグレット

node.description:
Witch Regret is a machine part of the Four Shining Stars. She is responsible for defending Edens Zero. Her power, Shield Ether, allows her to produce barriers made of Ether. 

Witch is very dutiful and holds a deep respect to Ziggy and his adoptive grandson Shiki. Although she is usually emotionless, Witch is capable of showing emotions. She finds it embarrassing to show her face to other people.

Hermit Mio is an android who's the member of the Four Shining Stars. Her power, Master Code, is a type of Program Hacking. Hermit likes clothes and video games, and used to dislike humans, but not anymore.

Sister Ivry is a machine part of the Four Shining Stars. Her power, Heal Atomizer, is a Healing Ether ability that allows her to mend wounds, undo negative status effects, and repair living machines. Sister is short tempered, enjoys teasing, and has a laid-back attitude, but she is also dutiful and can be friendly to her allies. She has a sadistic side and enjoys torture. She dislikes things that can't be healed.

Sister is shown to be someone who cannot accept death as a finality for machines, going as far to believe machines can be brought back by using the cloud's stored data.

Pino is a miniature anti-bot machine who joins the crew of Edens Zero. She can emit bursts of electromagnetic pulses, also known as EMP, that short out electronics for a few seconds and cancel out Ether Gear when it's in use.

Her digital avatar resembles a young human girl with rabbit-like ears. She wears a necktie that is decorated with a single large heart.

Happy is a machine cat from the planet Excede, Rebecca Bluegarden's companion, and a member of the Edens Zero's crew. His ability "Happy Blasters" allows him to transform into a pair of guns that fire Ether bullets. These bullets are powerful enough to incapacitate their targets, but won't kill them.

~!Happy was a cat found by Rebecca when he was young. He instantly became friends with her due to them sharing common life events. He received his name "Happy" from Rebecca for making her happy by becoming her friend. Sometime later, an accident occurred where a drunk driver ran over Happy, which ended up killing him. Thanks to Professor Weisz, he was revived into a machine body and continued his friendship with Rebecca.!~

name.native: ラビリア・クリスティ

node.description: Labilia Christy is an adventurer and B-Cuber who works at the Shooting Starlight guild.

name.native: エルシー・クリムゾン

node.description: One of the Oración Seis Galáctica, the captain of the pirate ship Skull Fairy, and the leader of her own pirate crew, as well as a fleet of space pirates. An old friend of Ziggy's.
An android that was once known as the "Demon King".  He raised Shiki and taught him the value of making friends.

Xiaomei is shown to have a calm and serious disposition as well as knowledgeable due to her precognition abilities.

Due to her precognition abilities not being able to tell a single outcome, it is shown that Xiaomei has an interest in watching people battle and this interest grows to the point where she becomes visibly excited and aroused.

Mosco is a machine tasked with the chores on board of the Edens Zero and a former mercenary from the team Rogue Out. He is an expert sumo wrestler who uses sumo techniques to fight. He likes Sister and little animals, but dislikes ghosts.

Valkyrie had the figure of a slim woman with a dark skin tone, and long, red-colored hair tied in a ponytail. She was very tall, taller than all other Shining Stars. She wore a light-colored, form-fitting, and armored battle suit with green gauntlets, pauldrons, and a pair of winged boots with "E1" on her chest.

Michael is a short machine with a very simple design. His head is maroon, large and ovular in shape; he has no visible eyes but two sunken holes in their place, and he has thin, rod-like neck and limbs. He wears a pointed hat and a green cloak with golden stripes and covers his hands with white fabric gloves.

Castellan was a machine that looked much like an elderly king. He wore a dark-colored robe, trimmed with fur with the symbol of Granbell Kingdom emblazoned on the back. As well as a multi-color, stripped crown on his head. He had a thick mustache and beard and gear-like decorations around both of his eyes. When entering into battle, Castellan discarded his robe revealing a robotic-body similar to a medieval knight's armor.
He is a popular B-Cuber who is inspired by a [german youtuber](https://www.youtube.com/user/ninotakutv). He is also a former member of the Zaiten Three.
He is the captain of the Edens One and follow the order of Ziggy.
She is the former leader of Sun Jewel and the mother of Homura Kogestu.

Jinn is a cyborg who was in the team "Rogue Out". His power, Wind Rage, is a type of Ether Gear that uses wind similarly to a typhoon. Jinn likes his sister Kleene and dislikes any man that approaches her. ~!After Rogue Out, he works under Drakken Joe with his sister, Kleene.!~
He was an infamous hacker renowned in the Sakura Cosmos. He was also affiliated with Drakken Joe of the Oración Seis Galáctica.
She was a machine who led the mercenary squad Rogue Out and was impersonating Sister Ivry, one of the Four Shining Stars.
She is part of Drakken Joe Crew and like her name says, she is a Space Slime
She is an agent from the Galactic Intelligence Agency and have the ability to take the apparence of someone.

He is the leader of a gang of criminals who operated on Planet Norma in the year X442. He appears later as an elderly man and an older version of Sibir from X442. He works for Drakken Joe as a in-debt slave.
He is an agent of the Galactic Intelligence Agency who is undercover as a member of Elsie Crimson's crew. Later, Elsie admit that she knows about him and ejected him from her ships.

node.description: He is the Director of the Galactic Intelligence Agency in the Sakura Cosmos. He is currently working undercover as the Guild Master of Shooting Starlight. His Ether Gear is name Eye of God, he can observe where people are with that.
He is a criminal that is collecting B-Cubers on Guilst.
He is one of the Oración Seis Galáctica, the former owner of the Belial Gore, and the most notorious man in the Sakura Cosmos underworld. Element 4 is under his order.
He is a member of the Interstellar Union Army. He is also the commander of the commando carrier Angel Feather and one of the Oración Seis Interestelar. His main goal is to capture Elsie Crimson.
She has her own video channel
Bernadette is an alien rabbit woman who works as a waitress in Norma's seedy underworld. She has an older counterpart living outside the post-Chronophage eaten Norma.
John was one of the many machines of Granbell. He ran the tailor shop in Granbell Kingdom.
Neepa is the leader of a gang of thugs on Blue Garden.
Mithra was one of the many machines of Granbell. She ran the bar in Granbell Kingdom.
Annie was one of the machines of Granbell. She ran the restaurant in the kingdom.
A mercenary from the team Rogue Out tasked with abducting B-Cubers on Planet Blue Garden.
A B-Cuber who was abducted together with Rebecca Bluegarden. She runs the food-centric Mogumogu Channel on B-Cube where her content revolves around eating.

A B-Cuber who was abducted together with Rebecca Bluegarden. She runs Tokkō TV, a B-Cube channel that produces fully scripted suspense videos where she enters into dangerous situations and escape them.
A B-Cuber who was abducted together with Rebecca Bluegarden. She co-stars with a giant koala on her B-Cube channel.
Müller is a rogue scientist from the planet Newton and was the former head of the Müller Royal Laboratories.
A sentient computer program housed within a robotic body who served as a member of Drakken Joe's team.
Jaguar is the Colonel of the Interstellar Union Army and a member of the Oración Seis Interestelar.
Diego Reyes is an android and former member of Drakken Joe's team.
Johnny was one of the robots found by Shiki who were treated as toys and discarded by Sibir.

name.native: ルーシィ・ハートフィリア

node.description:
A mage from the Fairy Tail guild who wields Celestial Spirit magic.

Lucy is cheerful, clever, and often gets swept along by her disruptive guildmates when they go overboard. Empathetic, caring, and more likely to write novels than wage battles, Lucy becomes most emboldened to challenge enemies when she needs to fight for her friends. She is said to be a noisy and somewhat fussy person, and there are times when she can be naive and too easily forgiving, greedy for validation as well as overly confident at inopportune moments. However, despite any failings and instances of self-doubt, she doesn't allow herself to feel down for too long - her optimism is boundless.

In July of Earth Land year X784, Lucy is a normal 17-year-old Fioran who wishes to join the infamous mage guild, Fairy Tail - although they have a reputation for being thoroughly destructive, she admires their strength and numbers. After a fateful meeting with two members of the guild in the town of Hargeon, [Natsu Dragneel](https://anilist.co/character/5187/Dragneel-Natsu) and his flying blue cat, [Happy](https://anilist.co/character/5188/Happy), she travels with them back to Fairy Tail, located in Magnolia, to begin the adventure of a lifetime.

~!Lucy's surname is quickly revealed to be quite significant, for it distinguishes her as a member of the Heartfilia family, who head a powerful and wealthy organization called the Heartfilia Konzern. The Heartfilia's connection to Celestial Sprit Magic becomes a key point later on.!~

A mage from the Fairy Tail Guild who wields fire dragon slayer magic.

Natsu has a carefree and reckless nature and, despite his constant brawls with the other members of the guild, is a fiercely loyal and protective friend. He has a particularly close and competitive relationship with [Gray Fullbuster](https://anilist.co/character/4839/Fullbuster-Gray) and [Erza Scarlet](https://anilist.co/character/5189/Scarlet-Erza). With the former, he has had a constant rivalry from a young age and although they often denounce each other as not being friends, they regularly watch each others' back even when they are enraged with one another. He has had the same sort of relationship with Erza - the two both being scared of her since a young age - and they seemed to have a fairly good relationship in the past as, according to Erza, they used to shower together. He befriends people rather quickly too, considering [Lucy](https://anilist.co/character/5186/Heartfilia-Lucy) a friend and willing to team up with her only after a few days of knowing her.

[Igneel](https://anilist.co/character/40157/Igneel), a dragon, found him in the forest and ended up taking care of him. He taught Natsu how to speak, read, and use magic. But one day Igneel disappeared without a trace. Because of this, Natsu's goal in life is to find him. 

~!Natsu is also among the five Dragon Slayers sent to the future from four hundred years past, having an additional purpose in the assistance of the defeat of [Acnologia](https://anilist.co/character/49003/Acnologia).!~

~!He is the younger brother of [Zeref Dragneel](https://anilist.co/character/37720/Zeref), having originally died 400 years ago, being subsequently revived as his brother's most powerful Etherious: E.N.D.!~

name.native: ミラジェーン・ストラウス

node.description:
__Title:__ The Demon
__Occupation:__ Mage
__Known relatives:__ [Elfman Strauss](https://anilist.co/character/5334); [Lisanna Strauss](https://anilist.co/character/30225).

She is a former S-class mage and the older sister of Elfman. When Mirajane was an S-class mage, she was known as "The Demon." However, due to a past incident involving the death of her younger sister, Lisanna, Mirajane somehow lost much of her magical ability and her will to fight. Given the recent event of Elfman regaining his lost abilities and Mirajane's increased confidence, Mirajane may someday regain her abilities and move forward with her life.

Mirajane plays a motherly role within the guild, and is often seen running the bar at the guild hall. She has rarely been shown to be in a bad mood, and can tolerate all of the guild's eccentricities. However, there have been a couple events that have disturbed Mirajane, including her discovery of the stealing of an S-Class job by [Natsu](https://anilist.co/character/5187), [Happy](https://anilist.co/character/5188) and [Lucy](https://anilist.co/character/5186), and her later disappointment with [Laxus](https://anilist.co/character/8294) following the destruction of the guild building.

The strange creature that [Haru](https://anilist.co/character/3749) discovered, Plue is the Rave Bearer, and is able to sense the presence of the other Rave Stones. Plue's nose also has the ability to destroy dark brings. Plue is quite fond of sweets - especially lollipops. Plue hates pudding. He has the ability to utilize the rave of conflict which powers him and Haru up.

Plue has since shown up in Fairy Tail as one of [Lucy](https://anilist.co/character/5186)'s stellar spirits (Nicola, Canis Minor) and quickly named Plue and has been noted to only agree to be summoned on Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays.  (Source: Wikipedia)

Angel is a mage who belongs to the Oración Seis guild, a Dark guild composed of highly powerful mages, as well as the only female within the group. She along with the others' goal is to find the power know as Nirvana, a very destructive power that was sealed away long ago. She a highly accomplished Celestial Spirit Mage however no better then Karen Lilica as she treats her spirit just as cruelly as the former Blue Pegasus member. Incidentally she was also the murderer of Karen herself.     She is also celestial spirit mage whose spirits are apparently fed up with her since meeting Lucy. She has the ability to summon two celestial spirits at the same time.    Gemini: Her formerly most used Celestial Spirit who is able to copy peoples' looks, memories and powers at will. Their names are Gemi and Mini. They have recently been transferred to Lucy's possession.    Scorpio: A man with a large, gun-like scorpion tail who refers to himself in the plural first person. He is Aquarius' boyfriend.    Aries: Karen's old Celestial Spirit used on Loke, acquired from Karen after Angel killed her. Her abilities are unknown.    Caelum: A spirit that can be wielded like a cannon as well as a sword.     (Source: Fairy Tail Wikia)

Jet is a member of the Fairy Tail Guild's team Shadow Gear, along with Levy and Droy. His magic, God's Leg, is a type of magic which dramatically increases his speed.  His real name is Sarusuke, with his nickname 'Jet', presumably coming from his type of magic.  - fairytail.wikia.com

Droy is a member of Fairy Tail Guild's team Shadow Gear, along with Levy and Jet.  Droy controls Rapid-Growing Plants to battle. He wears something called "Live-Coal" containers holding seeds for his magic.  (Source: Fairy Tail Wikia)

__Height:__ 155cm 
__Magic:__ Solid Script Mage

Levy is a member of the Fairy Tail Guild's team Shadow Gear, along with Jet and Droy. She has a cheerful personality, being able to get along with many other guild members. Levy loves to read books, she and Lucy Heartfilia quickly became friends through their mutual love for books. Levy read the novel that Lucy is working on and is the only person who has done so by consent.
Levy's magic is called Solid Script. Which allows her to make words solid and then throw the words at her opponent. For instance, if the word fire were to be thrown at her opponent the victim would feel as if he were hit by a fireball.

name.native: リサーナ・ストラウス

node.description:
Lisanna is the younger sister of both [Elfman](https://anilist.co/character/5334) and [Mirajane](https://anilist.co/character/5190), and is also a member of Fairy Tail, like her siblings her magic is take over. Her member stamp was on her upper left shoulder and now is on Left Thigh.

~!It is also very possible that Lisanna, Elfman and Mirajane operated in a three man group similar to Shadow Gear. She lost her life while trying to revert Elfman after his full-body Take Over went awry. He quickly lost control of himself and went on a rampage. Lisana gave her life trying to calm him down and stop his rampage. How she actually was able to do this is unknown. The mental and emotional trauma that Elfman and Mirajane both experienced after Lisana's death crippled their powers considerably. Mirajane lost her S-class rank and has not fought since. Elfman suffered major emotional damage and was incapable to cast his full body takeover spell for some time. When he did try casting it, a flashback to Lisana caused him to lose concentration. When Lisanna was younger, she seemed to be very kind like Elfman and unlike Mirajane. She wanted to help [Natsu Dragneel](https://anilist.co/character/5187) raise an unknown egg to see what comes out of it, being a little more knowledgeable in it then Natsu. After seeing a softer side of the usually flamboyant Natsu, she stated that he was a lot like her sister and joked that perhaps later she should become his bride which predictably freaked him out. It is shown that while the Earth Land version of Lisanna is deceased, the Edoras version of Lisanna is still alive. Like her Earth land counterpart, she seems just as friendly and caring, as seen when she scolds [Lucy](https://anilist.co/character/40437) for bullying Natsu and tells Jet and Droy not to pick on [Elfman](https://anilist.co/character/51087). When Natsu and [Happy](https://anilist.co/character/5188) see her they both shed tears and tried to hug her in joy, this freaked her out. She doesn't seem to have the massive crush her Earth Realm counterpart has on Natsu.!~

~!In chapter 199, it is told that the Earth Realm Lisanna was sucked into Edoras and didn't die. After she was taken back to the Earthland by the reverse anima. She was found by [PantherLily](https://anilist.co/character/33526) and taken to Natsu and the others. There she explained everything to them and go back to the Fairy Tail Guild!~
